Parse blastn hits into ranked reference candidates + a contamination screen

Source: R/blast_genbank.R
parse_blast_candidates.Rd

Reads a blastn -outfmt "6 saccver stitle pident qcovs evalue staxids" file for one sample and splits it two ways:

Usage

parse_blast_candidates(
  con,
  id,
  path = 1L,
  scaffold = 1L,
  hits_file,
  taxdump_dir = NULL,
  review = FALSE
)

Arguments

con

Open project DB connection.

id

Sample ID.

path, scaffold

Assembly unit within the sample.

hits_file

blastn outfmt-6 output (or a "NO_SIGNIFICANT_HITS" sentinel).

taxdump_dir

Optional pinned taxdump for resolving the screen hit's lineage. Without it the lineage is left NA, which curation flags rather than treats as clean.

review

TRUE stores the hits of the contig's review copy in review_blast_hits and calls derive_blast_products() in review mode. The sample's lineage taxids are never filled in.

Value

(invisibly) the ranked candidate data.frame.

Details

  • Reference panel - hits whose title is nuclear rDNA. Deduped by accession (best pident*qcovs), ranked into blast_ref_candidates, rank-1 written to the unit's assemblies.blast_* columns. Same records the restricted search returned before.

  • Contamination screen - the top hit of the whole search (the bundled rDNA database with its decoys, or NCBI core_nt), unfiltered, into blast_screen. This is the only signal that can distinguish "the host" from "a symbiont" or "not nuclear rDNA at all", so it is deliberately taken before the nuclear-rDNA filter.
